name: Naru Mahjong
source:
Four people gathered in Naru's room for a meeting to make an adventure game. However, Chizuru who is in charge of the scenario, Mako who is in charge of music, and Emi who is in charge of the program are all dreaminging of finding the mythical creature "Tsuchinoko". So Naru's older sister Aimi says, "Why don't you make a mahjong game instead?"

However, Naru doesn't know anything about mahjong. If she doesn't know, she just has to learn, so they decided to hold a mahjong tournament, with the rule that losers must accept naughty punishment.
translation:
四个人聚集在Naru的房间里，开会讨论制作冒险游戏。然而，负责剧本的Chizuru、负责音乐的Mako，以及负责程序的Emi，却都一心想着寻找传说中的生物“土龙”。于是，Naru的姐姐Aimi提议：“不如改做麻将游戏吧？”

可是，Naru对麻将一窍不通。既然不会，那就现学，于是大家决定举办一场麻将比赛，并规定输家必须接受香艳的惩罚。
